sections.heading: SPECIALIZATION IN RELIGION AND SOCIETY
lines: 2.0 courses normally taken in second year: Religious Studies 2201F/G, Religious Studies 2202F/G, Religious Studies 2203F/G, either Religious Studies 2205F/G or Religious Studies 2218F/G.
0.5 course: Religious Studies 2200F/G, normally taken in year 2 or 3.
0.5 course from: Religious Studies 2134A/B, Religious Studies 2207E*.
5.0 additional courses in Religious Studies at the 2100 level or above, except Religious Studies 2208U, Religious Studies 3308U and Religious Studies 4408Y **.
Note: Students wishing to retain the option of upgrading to one of the other Catholic Studies modules should use 2200 level courses.
* Students using Religious Studies 2207E to meet module requirements need only take an additional 4.5 Religious Studies courses at the 2200 level or above.

**Students using Philosophy 2660E to meet module requirements need only take an additional 4.5 Religious Studies courses at the 2100 level or above. If both Religious Studies 3300F/G and Philosophy 2660E are taken, Philosophy 2660E may still be counted as a Religious Studies course at the 2200 level.

Note: This module requires Religious Studies 2203F/G, which has Religious Studies 1023E as an antirequisite. Students who have completed Religious Studies 1023E must substitute an alternate 0.5 course in Religious Studies at the 2200 level.
